description: This PHP source file defines the class `PinpointSMSVoiceClient`, which serves as a client to interact with the Amazon Pinpoint SMS and Voice Service. It mainly contains method annotations for various operations related to configuration sets and voice messaging, used for communication with the AWS SDK.

classes.name: PinpointSMSVoiceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon Pinpoint SMS and Voice Service, extending the base AwsClient.

methods.name: createConfigurationSet
methods.description: Creates a new configuration set for the Pinpoint SMS and Voice service.

methods.name: createConfigurationSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new configuration set.

methods.name: createConfigurationSetEventDestination
methods.description: Creates a new event destination within a configuration set.

methods.name: createConfigurationSetEventDestinationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new event destination.

methods.name: deleteConfigurationSetEventDestination
methods.description: Deletes an event destination from a configuration set.

methods.name: getConfigurationSetEventDestinations
methods.description: Retrieves event destinations for a configuration set.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a voice message via the service.

methods.name: updateConfigurationSetEventDestination
methods.description: Updates an event destination within a configuration set.
